protocol: single-seed decomposition of denominator dilution and modality whitelist
purpose: Separate actual-uploader denominator renormalization from modality-whitelist filtering in the U-to-R difference.

fixed_controls.empty_region_metrics: existing fixed Dice, IoU, and HD95 rules
fixed_controls.upload_boundary: active optimizer named parameters only; buffers remain server-owned

U.formula: Delta_p^U = sum_k(n_k * Delta_{k,p}) / sum_k(n_k), with a missing upload treated as Delta_{k,p}=0

N.eligible_clients: actual uploaders of parameter p, without reading modality
N.formula: Delta_p^N = sum_{k:p uploaded}(n_k * Delta_{k,p}) / sum_{k:p uploaded}n_k
N.numeric_zero_rule: an uploaded parameter remains eligible when its numerical delta is zero
N.empty_uploader_rule: preserve theta_p^t and record an audit event

R.eligible_clients: actual uploaders of parameter p whose modality is allowed for G(p)
R.formula: Delta_p^R = sum_{k:p uploaded and modality-compatible}(n_k * Delta_{k,p}) / sum_{k:p uploaded and modality-compatible}n_k

acceptance.aggregation_level: N and R must have identical eligible uploaders, normalized weights, and aggregated parameters for every valid optimizer-scoped upload payload
acceptance.training_level: compare N and R round-level and final metrics under the declared best-effort CUDA reproducibility boundary
acceptance.interpretation: attribute N-U to missing-upload denominator dilution and R-N to additional modality-whitelist filtering
